text:
Priya: quick sync — we need a decision today on retention + backfill plan for the new runtime metrics (route_latency, batch_size_hist). Product needs numbers for the UI quotas and console. cc @Mia @Jon :eyes:
Mia: thanks — can you list which exporters will emit these? iirc runtime-exporter v2 emits route_latency and kv_cache_hits, but batch_size_hist is only from scheduler-exporter.
Priya: correct. Proposed minimal contract: runtime-exporter -> route_latency, kv_cache_hits (90d); scheduler-exporter -> batch_size_hist, batch_wait_ms (30d). aggregates (1y).
Jon: prefer 60d on batch_size_hist — it's high-card if we keep label dimensions (model, size). Also want to keep raw at lower cardinality and full detail in aggregates.
Sasha: echo Jon. if we keep (model, shard, route) tags fully, storage spikes. can we emit a reduced label set for raw and keep full tags for aggregates?
Priya: that's the idea. raw_low_card: labels=(model,route). raw_full -> only stored in hourly aggregates. We'll document in the metrics contract.
Carlos: from console POV: quota calc needs 30/90/365 windows to show trends. If retention differs we'll need to change the timeline picker. prefer the 30/90/365 buckets for UX consistency.
Mia: ok — mapping proposal: raw_low_card = 90d, raw_high_card = 30d but only at 1m resolution, aggregates (hourly/daily) = 365d. Backfill: 30 days of raw_low_card, 7 days of raw_high_card.
Jon: rough cost estimate: backfilling 30d raw_low_card across prod clusters ~ 14 TB compressed, ~ $6k egress+ingest. Need signoff from infra budget.
Priya: can infra run a quick backfill cost check? @infra-bot can you run estimate for: exporters=[runtime-exporter,v2,scheduler-exporter] window=30d resolution=1m
infra-bot: Received backfill-cost-check request from Priya. Starting estimation job 1847654321-01...
infra-bot: Estimation complete: estimated ingest ~13.6 TB compressed, compute ~1200 vCPU-hours on nightly mapreduce, est infra cost $5,900 (±20%). Detailed breakdown uploaded: https://internal.redwood/ops/backfill/1847654321
Sasha: can we reduce compute cost by using incremental snapshot+replay instead of full reprocess? i.e., if we have prefix caches maybe skip sections.
Jon: good idea. scheduler-exporter stores per-slot snapshot in s3 prefix /snapshots/scheduler/YYYYMMDD — we could reuse. I can wire a flag in the backfill job to prefer snapshots if present. That should cut compute ~40%.
Priya: decision checklist for today:
- retention windows: raw_low_card=90d, raw_high_card=30d, aggregates=365d ✅
- backfill window: raw_low_card=30d, raw_high_card=7d (use snapshots where available) ✅
- exporter contract doc: Mia to draft PR to metrics-contracts repo by EOD ✅
- infra budget approval: Carlos to push cost to infra-billing for signoff ✅
Mia: I'll open the PR. quick sketch in the thread for the metrics-contracts YAML:```
# metrics-contracts/runtime-metrics.yaml
metrics:
  - name: route_latency
    exporters: [runtime-exporter]
    labels: [model, route]
    retention: 90d
    resolution: 1m
  - name: batch_size_hist
    exporters: [scheduler-exporter]
    labels: [model, route, size_bucket]
    retention: 30d
    resolution: 1m
aggregates:
  hourly: 365d
  daily: 365d
backfill_policy:
  raw_low_card_days: 30
  raw_high_card_days: 7
```
Carlos: For billing I'll need the infra-bot report linked and the reduced compute plan. please add an estimated date for backfill (we'd prefer low traffic weekend).
Priya: proposed backfill start: Sat 2026-05-09 00:00 UTC, duration ~36h (with snapshot reuse). Mia/Jon ok?
Jon: ok from runtime side, will add snapshot-reuse flag and smoke test on staging by Fri.
Mia: ok will include schedule in PR and add console UI hooks for retention selector (30/90/365) and note temporary reduced historical detail for raw_high_card.
Sasha: dev-ops note — add an alert if backfill ingest rate > 1.5x baseline, and a kill-switch to pause backfill. I'll put alert runbook in oncall playbook.
Priya: perfect. merging decisions into the playbook doc after Mia's PR. thanks all :tada:
Carlos: +1 — will slate billing approval and ping finance after infra signoff.
infra-bot: Backfill job ticket created: BF-1847654321, assign to @Jon and @Sasha. Monitor channel: #backfill-ops.
Jon: will pick up BF-1847654321. I'll post progress updates in #backfill-ops.
Mia: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/metrics-contracts/pulls/142 — includes retention table + console flags.
Priya: closing loop — we'll run a short post-backfill validation: compare route_latency p95 between pre and post to ensure no data loss. if weirdness, rollback aggregates and rerun.
Carlos: thanks team. short follow-up: can we add a small UX note on console explaining why some historic data may be coarse? i'll draft copy once PR merges. :memo:
